summary: Iteration 3 of hyrz demo data, chats and payslip PDFs. Backend: I wrote a new pytest suite (16 tests) and all 16 pass. It covers the demo seed for shifts, applications, checkouts, invoices, direct chats, workchats and admin threads, plus clock-in, direct and workchat send/react/reply, the read-only past workchat, payslips and pay-settings validation. UI checks with Playwright at 1920x1080 that pass: worker dashboard with Today's shift; Clock in (POST 201, card changes to Clocked in + Clock out); worker inbox tabs and seeded chats with unread badges (Sam 2, admin 1); worker direct chat (react and reply both send POSTs, GIF renders); employer direct chat via the Employers tab (react, reply and send; composer is above the nav); payslip list (5 weekly PAYE payslips); expanding and downloading a payslip gives hyrz-payslip-2026-27-week-30.pdf, 7.8 KB, a valid PDF with correct content; the three pay-settings errors show inline; admin login and the admin inbox. Still failing: (1) the workchat reaction picker and Reply still do nothing (the iteration-2 fix is not effective); (2) the employer workchat showed a huge pin SVG that hid the composer (I fixed this with CSS); (3) the worker Completed tab is always empty and Upcoming includes past shifts; (4) on the employer inbox All tab, clicking a direct chat does nothing; (5) the employer inbox tabs render below the list.

minor.issue: Seeded reaction emojis 🙋/🤞 are not in the allowed list, so users cannot toggle them (only display). Cosmetic.
The two submitted 'Bartender – Late Bar' checkouts look identical in the UI. The cards show no worker name, so the employer cannot tell Alex from Leo.

ui_bugs.component: Workchat reaction picker and message actions (worker AND employer)
ui_bugs.issue: Tapping an emoji in .workchat-reaction-picker sends no POST and adds no reaction. Tapping Reply in .workchat-message-actions does not set the reply preview, so the message goes out with replyToMessageId=null. Cause (App.jsx ~line 14-22, closeOpenSections): the open trigger is the bubble (.workchat-message-bubble with aria-expanded=true). The code computes container = trigger.closest(containers), which is the bubble itself. The picker and actions are SIBLINGS of the bubble, not children, so container.contains(target) is false. trigger.click() then runs on pointerdown, deselects the message and unmounts the picker before the click lands. Adding the classes to the list cannot help. Fix: at the top of closeOpenSections add `if (event.target.closest('.workchat-reaction-picker,.workchat-message-actions')) return;`, or wrap bubble + picker + actions in one element and use that as the container.

The .workchat-pin-icon svg rendered at 1892x1892px in the employer workchat. Its size CSS only exists under .worker-workchat-panel (styles.css:13162-13167). This pushed the composer to y=2342 and the view did not scroll, so the composer could not be reached. I appended a global `.workchat-pin-icon svg{width:19px;height:19px}` rule to styles.css, and the composer now sits at y=1019 and works. Still unstyled for employers: the pinned cards show huge arrow SVGs, use the default font, and the card layout is broken. Copy the pinned-section styles to the employer view.

The Completed tab filters app.status==='completed', but the applications.status enum is pending/approved/rejected/withdrawn, so Completed is always empty. The Upcoming tab filters app.status==='approved' with no date check, so it lists all 15 approved shifts, including 13 past ones (e.g. Harvest Fair from 27 days ago). Fix: Upcoming = approved && ends_at > now; Completed = approved && ends_at <= now (or shift.status==='completed' / has an approved checkout).

Clicking a direct conversation (e.g. Alex Demo) in the All tab only calls setActiveDirectConversation. The employer DirectChatRoom is not rendered for inboxTab 'all', so nothing opens. The workchat branch already calls setInboxTab('workchats'); the direct-chat branch should also switch to setInboxTab('employers').
A stray '0' appears under 'Recorded times'. Cause: `{checkout.is_test&&...}` with is_test=0 renders 0. Use `Number(checkout.is_test)>0&&`. The Approve button is an unstyled browser-default button.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the workchat reaction picker and Reply. In closeOpenSections, return early when event.target is inside .workchat-reaction-picker or .workchat-message-actions; the current containers list is checked against the trigger's own closest() and never matches the sibling picker.
HIGH: Style the employer workchat pinned section (arrow SVGs, fonts, card layout). The pin icon is fixed by my global CSS rule; keep it or scope it properly.
HIGH: Worker Upcoming/Completed tabs: base them on shift end time rather than the non-existent application status 'completed'.
HIGH: Employer inbox All tab: opening a direct chat must also setInboxTab('employers') (or render DirectChatRoom for 'all').
MEDIUM: Employer inbox: move the header and tabs above the list; rename the employer's 'Employers' tab to 'Workers'.
MEDIUM: Checkout cards: fix the stray '0' (is_test&&), show the worker name, and style the Approve button.

LOW: Group admin messages into threads in the worker and employer inbox; remove the duplicate sign-out icon; fix low-contrast active pills and the quote inside own bubbles; remove the duplicated composer icons in the employer workchat.
critical_code_review_comments: App.jsx is 1644 very long single-line JSX lines (some 100k+ chars) and styles.css is over 13k lines with many !important page-scoped overrides. That is why styles applied to the worker workchat (.worker-workchat-panel) are missing in the employer view. Extract a shared Workchat component and CSS, the way chat/* was done for direct chats.

closeOpenSections clicks every aria-expanded trigger on any pointerdown. This is fragile: any popover rendered outside its trigger's closest() container breaks. Prefer per-component outside-click handling.

seed-demo-data.js uses string-interpolated SQL in wipe() (ids are numeric DB values, so the risk is low) and leaves workchat_typing/direct_typing rows behind. It is fine for test data only and is guarded by DB_NAME==='hyrz_test'.
Clock-in has no time gate (you can clock in hours before the shift starts). Confirm this is intended.

success_rate.frontend: ~65% (worker dashboard, clock-in, inbox listing, direct chat both roles, payroll and PDF, pay-settings errors and admin inbox pass; workchat reactions/reply, employer workchat pinned styling, completed/upcoming tabs and employer All-tab open fail)

rca of the issue: Workchat reactions: in closeOpenSections, container = trigger.closest(list), and the trigger is the bubble, so the container is the bubble. The picker is the bubble's sibling, so container.contains(target) is false and trigger.click() deselects the message on pointerdown, before the emoji's onClick fires. Reproduce: worker → Inbox → Riverside Fest Crew → click the 'Weather update' bubble → click 👍: no /reactions request. Employer composer: the giant unscoped SVG pin icon (CSS only under .worker-workchat-panel).
